description: Helping Hands live page cleanup. Jake (voice, viewing the Helping Hands live site on localhost, 2026-10-20): 'Let's remove the only. Remove all of those things, the things that say only. And then remove the little check.' Remove every label/badge on the live page that says 'only' (all of them), and remove the small checkmark indicator shown with them.
test_instructions: Open the Helping Hands live page: no element says 'only'.
The small checkmark is gone and the layout still looks clean.

results.identified_issue: The 'Only' labels were the per-piece isolate buttons built in pieceRows() (gallery.js) with their .only CSS in index.html; deleted the button, its handler and CSS. 'The little check' was read as the '✓ ' prefix on follow notes (a part that followed a change) in partRow(); removed just the glyph, kept the note text and the ⚠ warning on incompatible pairs. If Jake meant the eye toggle or the whole follow note, that's the next turn. Ran Scripts/test_gallery.py (5 OK) and a module syntax check; did not eyeball it in a browser.
results.summary: Removed every 'Only' button and the little checkmark from the live preview's parts panel
results.detailed_description: Every piece row in the parts panel had an 'Only' button on its right (tap to show just that piece). Those are gone, button, click handler and styling, so each row is now just the eye, the color swatch and the name. The eye still hides and shows pieces. The small ✓ in front of the 'follows' notes under a part's version picker is gone too; the note text stays, and the ⚠ warning for parts that don't fit together is unchanged. If the check you meant was a different one (for example the eye toggle), tell me and I'll take that out instead. The gallery tests pass.

summary: The Helping Hands live page shows labels or badges reading "only", each paired with a small checkmark indicator. Remove every "only" label on the page and also remove the checkmark shown alongside them.
